critical_code_review_comments: JRN-103 journey text says request 8 delivery '9:45am' but engine returns arrival_label '9:44am' (584 minutes = 9:44am). Off by one minute due to rounding — cosmetic, below the 'few minutes' tolerance; worth aligning journey copy or rounding to 9:45am for consistency.

pytest default addopts still parallelises (-n 2 --dist loadscope) while suites mutate shared demo + AI config state; must be invoked with '-n 0'. Previous iteration flagged the same — recommend setting -n 0 as default or acquiring a MongoDB-level lock.

accept.optimized is returned as a dict with before/after miles when improved, which matches JRN-105 wording ('reports whether Van 2 was re-optimized'). If a boolean shape is ever desired by UI copy, document the field schema near engine_api.engine_accept.

success_rate.backend: 100% on in-scope suites (82/82 after excluding 2 by-design stub tests); Q-53 optimizer_check 0 breaks/0 moves

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend as `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v -n 0 -o addopts='' --junitxml=...` — xdist breaks shared demo state. TestStubLLM::test_stub_connect_and_read_tags_our_model and TestStandInLabel::test_stub_reads_and_tags_as_test_stand_in fail by design because DEV_STUB_ENABLED=false; do NOT re-enable the stub. For optimizer_check: `API_URL=https://drivepast-preview.preview.emergentagent.com python /app/backend/scripts/optimizer_check.py` (not /api suffix — the script adds it). The /api/engine/accept 'optimized' response is a dict ({improved, saves_miles, saves_minutes, before_miles, after_miles}) when re-opt applied, not a bool. /api/engine/undo (POST, no body) is the single undo endpoint for both booking and route-apply (route-apply has its own /api/units/{key}/optimize/undo). Map geometry blocking: use page.route('**/api/map/geometry/**', fulfill 503) — note the leaflet-control-attribution always reads '© OpenStreetMap contributors · Routes © OSRM' regardless of cache state. JRN-107 cached return measured 0.87s locally — budget-safe under the 2s cap even on cold CI runners.
